IonFamilies: isotope and adduct annotation of LC-MS feature groups

Source: R/IonFamilies-package.R
IonFamilies-package.Rd

One compound gives several LC-MS features: its quasi-molecular ion, other adducts, in-source fragments, and the isotopes of all of these. This package annotates that ion family within groups of features, typically the groups made with MsFeatures::groupFeatures() on an xcms::XcmsExperiment.

Details

The workflow has two steps:

  1. annotateIsotopes() with an IsotopologueParam() finds isotope patterns with MetaboCoreUtils::isotopologues() and labels them in CAMERA syntax ([3][M]+, [3][M+1]+).

  2. annotateAdducts() with an AdductVoteParam() finds adducts and fragments by neutral-mass voting with a rule list (defaultAdductRules()). All supported hypotheses are kept and ranked (adductHints()); the best nBest are written as text (formatAdducts()).

Annotations are hints: they suggest what to check, they do not identify a compound.
